notes.title: CustomMap!!!!
notes.notes:
不安定な挙動が存在するため、まだアーリーアクセスとしていますが BulletLiveに待望のカスタムマップが追加されました！
これであなたの手持ちの楽曲を使ってのライブが可能になりました！
カスタムマップエディタはここ→https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lmc9IOgE0woqHWizwpCkPu53ZNrJ04ZJ?usp=sharing
エディタの使用方法についての解説動画は今日のそのうち
カスタムマップ楽曲の選択については楽曲選択ステージの左後あたりです！
さあ早くオリジナルのゲーム体験へ向かってください！！！！！

[previewyoutube=NwXjwe6P_yk;full][/previewyoutube]

Although still in Early Access due to the existence of unstable behavior, BulletLive has added a long-awaited custom map!
Now you can perform live shows with your own music!
The custom map editor is here -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lmc9IOgE0woqHWizwpCkPu53ZNrJ04ZJ?usp=sharing
An instructional video on how to use the editor will be available later today.
The custom map music selection is located to the rear left of the music selection stage!
Now head on over to the original game experience at ！！！！！

notes.title: Fixing Defects
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused the player to be automatically sent to the tutorial stage at the end of a song.

notes.title: Tentative changes to FOV for spectator cameras
notes.notes: Due to feedback from Ford backs that the FOV of the Spectator camera is too narrow, we have made a tentative change to increase the FOV to 1.3x. This change is temporary and we will add a setting to make the FOV setting variable in an update scheduled for mid-April.
